purpose: Plan 059 M3-B1a revision that preserves the frozen coverage and stop contract while closing repeated-text and exact candidate-length shortcuts

candidate_token_length_shortcut_contract.reject_when: an exact candidate-token threshold selects at least six candidates across at least two splits and every selected candidate has one Binary label
